description: The AVMK Frontier Labs team consists of 3 high school kids and 1 middle schooler from Houston, Texas. Our members are, Abyaz, Victor, Keerti, and Marvin. We are interested in space exploration, technology, coding, and exploring new ideas. We can turn creative concepts into real world solutions. We are excited to participate in this NASA hackathon to push our skills beyond the classroom, and build something that makes a difference.
